intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: Two damp maps lie on the stones, pinned down with pebbles. They disagree about everything.

intro.speaker: NERELLE
intro.text: “This is a surface map. The sea is a blue patch labeled ‘Sea.’”

intro.speaker: NERELLE
intro.text: “Ours, meanwhile, shows the land as a blank patch labeled ‘Dry. Possibly goats.’”

intro.speaker: PLAYER
intro.text: “So both sides gave up at the shoreline.”

intro.speaker: NERELLE
intro.text: “Each mapmaker drew home in exquisite detail, and the other side as a rumor.”

options.labelText: “Swap? You fix my sea, I’ll fix your goats.”

branch.speaker: NERELLE
branch.text: “A fair treaty. Though fixing your sea will take considerably longer.”

branch.speaker: NERELLE
branch.text: “There are eleven currents where yours says ‘Sea.’ Bring more pebbles.”

options.labelText: “Just draw roads across the sea part. Then nobody gets lost.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: On the blank land of her map, she adds a small note: *Wants roads in the sea.*
